Resolves #21710

`Neo.timeline.EventEditor` hands focus back to the bar it opened on. A bar is a node inside a grid row, not a component, so the dialog's return target (the component focus came from, else `animateTarget`) was the grid around it, and after a save nothing. While the editor holds focus and has a `barId`, `revertFocus()` and `revertFocusOnDeparture()` now have its owner focus that bar, on departure with `restoreFrom` so a focus the user moved meanwhile stays (#21415's rule). Without a `barId` both fall back to the dialog's behaviour. The scheduler and the Gantt share the editor.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium e2e on `gantt/basic`, `dev`'s `EventEditor.mjs` vs head's) → L3 required (focus in the browser). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 opened by double-click or Enter, focus returns to the bar on Escape, Cancel and Save | CI: `EditorFocus.spec.mjs`, its three tests |
| AC-2 opened without a bar, focus returns as a dialog's does | The diff: `#focusBar()` returns false without a `barId`, and both methods fall back to `super` |
| AC-3 red on `dev`, green at head | Outside CI: Test Evidence below |
| AC-4 scheduler, gantt and timeline specs stay green | CI: `unit`, `e2e-engine` |

## Test Evidence
`gantt/EditorFocus`, headless Chromium, 1440 × 900:

| `src/timeline/EventEditor.mjs` from | Result |
|---|---|
| `dev` `5851f7d976` | 3 failed: focus on `DIV#neo-grid-view-1` after Escape (double-click and Enter), and after Cancel |
| head `3d2acd55e5` | 9 passed (`--repeat-each 3`) |

A first draft overrode only `revertFocus()` and still failed: closing removes the editor's DOM, so the hand-back runs through `revertFocusOnDeparture()`, which a trace of one Escape showed for the editor, its header toolbar and its action button.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge OR documented search (per guide §7.1):**

- **Challenge**: Two non-blocking edge-case notes: (1) `#focusBar` targets `this.barId` captured at `openForRecord(record, barId)` (`EventEditor.mjs:147,664`). In Gantt (`showResourceField: false`) a task stays on its row across `Save`, whereas in `Neo.scheduler.Container` (`showResourceField: true`), saving a `resourceId` change in `EventEditor#save()` (`:784`) refreshes mounted rows before `me.hide()` (`:787`), moving the bar VDOM node to `${newRowId}__bar__${record.id}` (`owner.findBarId(record.id)`) while `this.barId` still names the prior row (`hypothesis — needs V-B-A before implementation` when Scheduler booking room edits are driven in #21615). (2) On `AC-2`, `Scheduler.Container#openEventEditor(id)` (`src/scheduler/Container.mjs:1278`) computes `barId || me.findBarId(record.id)`, so `barId` is `null` specifically when the target record's bar is unmounted/offscreen or `openForRecord(record, null)` is invoked directly; when the bar is mounted, programmatic `openTaskEditor(id)` resolves its `barId` and returns focus to that bar.
